page.layout: One page of running text in one column; a marginal note in the left margin beside "Sententia trium virorum".
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: quæ cum eâ cohærent, pactum item vetus de cerevisia, legem de frumento Σιτωνείῳ[?], denique stapulæ jus integrum in omnibus rebus venalibus domi natis aut peregrinis&importatis, relinqui sibi, & firmari petebat. Judices pronunciarunt hoc modo: Sententia iudicii IX-virorum definitiva.Sententia trium virorum deputatorum anno M. D. xcv lata abrogata esto. Civitas & ager una provincia, una ditio sunto, & conjunctim ab ordinibus suis reguntur. Omnia jura & reditus, qui quondam Principis fuêre, omnes item ex tributis recentibus omnis generis provenientes pecunia exercentur, & impendantur, quò debent, ex consensu communi partis utriusque: monasteria & bona monastica, & quæ ejus generis in urbe & agro, item in Præfectura vetere & suburbanâ conjunctis sententiis conferuntur in usus pios: ad administrationem pecuniæ publicæ & censuum, ac ad ea, quæ ab ordinibus decernentur exequenda & efficienda deliguntur viri idonei pari numero utraque à parte, iisq; mandata & munerum limites præscribuntor, cujusmodi è re esse provinciæ ordines putabunt: interea collegium ante biennium institutum, eâ formâ, quâ institutû est, maneto tantisper donec

page.notes: Greek word after "frumento" is uncertain (printed as a Greek form resembling Σιτωνείῳ); marked [?]. The catchword "nec" is printed at the lower right. The "Digitized by Google" watermark at the foot is excluded. The note "Sententia iudicii IX-virorum definitiva." is set in three short lines in the left margin and is given once as a single note. Long s has been normalised to s; printed spelling otherwise kept.
